name: title-readiness-start
purpose: iter-458 run (2') (Astra 038). H-READY: the title accepts input once it is READY and VISIBLE. Reaches the title exactly as hrr_title_ab.json / physfree_gameplay.json do (same first four steps); then requires BOTH the title UI tail (APT_REQ #15 HintB) AND a captured visible title (sustained non-black presented frames, the requireVisibleMs gate), settles 8 s, sends exactly ONE ENTER (START) and allows 30 s with NO further input - that interval is scored before anything else is pressed. Then gp3's post-dialog steps verbatim (their A presses double as the A fallback if START did nothing), and a 240 s observe. Run with SR_HRR_CACHE=1 and NO SR_HRR_CACHE_WINDOW, -TimeoutSeconds 900.

steps.name: title-ui-tail
steps.purpose: The title's last UI request. Necessary, not sufficient: in hrr2 it fired ~64 s before any visible frame.

steps.name: title-visible
steps.purpose: Gate-only step: post-entry presented frames must be non-black for 8 s continuously, then settle 8 s. No input until this passes.

steps.name: start-once
steps.purpose: H-READY: exactly ONE START, delivery verified by KBPAD_OBS; 30 s with no further input for the guest to open the storage flow (selector or ScrGenPop). Scored before any other key.

steps.name: settle-modepage
steps.purpose: gp3 verbatim: the next page came up ~54 s after ScrGenPop with no input.

steps.name: select-mode
steps.purpose: gp3 verbatim. Also the A fallback if START opened nothing (gp3: a held A on the ready title opened the selector).

steps.name: nav-down
steps.purpose: gp3 verbatim. DOWN is an EXTENDED key.

steps.name: observe-gameplay
steps.purpose: Four minutes to see whether the game leaves the front end (gp3: main_hud #17 and the HUD components #18-#24).
